parameters.query: SELECT m.id, m.full_name, m.max_workload, m.skills, COALESCE(m.productivity_score,100)::float AS productivity_score, COUNT(t.id) FILTER (WHERE t.status IN ('TODO','IN_PROGRESS','IN_REVIEW'))::int AS current_load FROM members m LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.assignee_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY m.full_name
